title: Net 30 across the November clock change is due on the 30th day
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the test location's time zone has daylight saving time.
  • Have work order 1, complete and ready to invoice (every part received, review done), for a customer who holds Net 30.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1's Finance tab.
  2. Set Invoice Date to Oct 20, 2026.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The invoice preview shows Invoice Date and Due date.

Step 2:

  • The Due date reads Nov 19, 2026 (Oct 20 + 30: 11 days to Oct 31, then 19; the clocks change on Nov 1, 2026).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S7-R10: “A Net 30 invoice or vendor invoice whose span crosses the March or November clock change is due on the 30th calendar day after its date.”
  • S7-R6: “Due dates are counted on the calendar of the location the invoice or vendor invoice belongs to, never the location of the user, API connection or import that creates or views it, so a daylight saving change inside the span never moves the date: an Edmonton invoice dated Oct 5 on "10th of the following month" is due Nov 10 (not Nov 9).”
